intro: Kyrion local installer. Your setup stays on this target. No AI, microphone, cloud keys or extra hardware is required. This candidate has not passed clean-host release acceptance.
unsupported: E_PLATFORM: This target has no supported provisioning path yet. Windows inventory does not mean Windows installation support. Use an isolated Debian 13 x64/ARM64 or 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13 candidate for testing. No system changes were made.
modes: Mode: fresh / resume / extend / repair / restore. Only fresh and matching-release resume are currently implemented.
maintenanceUnavailable: E_MODE: This maintenance operation is not implemented. Existing data is preserved; see docs/guided-installer.md for recovery boundaries.
existing: E_EXISTING_STATE: The target exists. Choose resume for an installation owned by this installer. Existing installations are not adopted or overwritten.
noResume: E_RESUME: No installer journal exists at the target.
trustRequired: E_TRUST: Supply --public-key with an independently trusted release public key. A key downloaded alongside an untrusted bundle is not sufficient.
hostname: Resolvable local hostname, for example kyrion.home.arpa
address: This target's private LAN IPv4 address
review: Review: the four verified images will be loaded; private keys and database configuration are created only for a fresh installation; PostgreSQL, Core, Web and Caddy start. HTTPS binds only to the selected LAN address. No router settings change. Docker Engine must already start as a system service. No additional runtime or model download is performed.
approve: Approve these system changes by typing INSTALL; anything else cancels
working: Verifying images, recording progress and starting services. This can take several minutes. Interruptions preserve state; rerun with the same target and release.
servicesHealthy: Core and local HTTPS login passed the current readiness check. Owner setup and recovery are still separate open steps.
certificate: Public local TLS certificate: trust it through your operating system after verifying its origin. Do not disable TLS verification. It expires after 365 days
handoff: Continue protected owner and Space setup in this installation's local Kyrion interface. Then optionally link the same identity through Profile/Identity and configure integrations through the existing catalog. Website passwords are never entered here. Home Assistant currently imports read-only devices. AI and voice can be skipped.
bootstrap: Read the bootstrap value privately from this protected file, not from logs (Core expiry: 30 minutes)
pending: Not yet configured by this installer: central account linking, recovery, backup schedule, update service, additional nodes, AI and voice. The installer does not claim these succeeded. Local administration remains available in Kyrion.
interrupted: E_INTERRUPTED: Progress was preserved. Resume the same installation; ambiguous partial files require inspection and are never silently replaced.
failed: Installation could not finish. Existing data and progress are preserved. Check prerequisites, the private install-state.json error code and docs/guided-installer.md, then resume the same release. No automatic deletion or restore was performed.
setupNow: Set up or sign in to your existing local Core account now? You can resume later
spaceName: Name of your new HOME Space (one Space per installation)
localUsername: Local username for the same identity you may link to your web account
localPassword: Local offline password (at least 12 characters; never your website password)
linkNow: Link this local identity to your web account through the configured provider?
linkLater: Central linking is skipped or unavailable. Local access works independently. Later linking uses Profile/Identity; it never creates membership in another Space.
hardwareHelp: Zigbee uses a coordinator; Matter is an application protocol; Thread is an IP network requiring a suitable Border Router. They are not interchangeable. Hardware managed by Home Assistant or another service must stay there; this installer claims no USB device.
hardwareChoice: Select any comma-separated items: ha, zigbee, matter, thread, audio, none. Unknown hardware ownership stays unknown
haExisting: An existing Home Assistant connection is configured. It is preserved. Edit or disconnect it in the local integration catalog.
haScope: Core verifies the connection and imports only your chosen devices and entities. Power control requires separate consent and a deliberate action.
haConsent: Connect Home Assistant with this explicit read-only import scope?
haEndpoint: Home Assistant private IPv4 base URL (http or trusted https)
haToken: Home Assistant access token (stored encrypted by Core, never by this installer)
haImported: Core confirmed connection and imported devices
tutorial: Open Devices to inspect imported states. Only devices declaring control capabilities can be controlled; try an action deliberately. Profile, Space, Integrations and System services remain available after setup.
alreadyLinked: This existing local identity is already linked; the mapping is preserved.
centralBrowser: Open this HTTPS address in your standard browser, verify the provider and sign in or register there. Return here afterward. Do not enter the website password in the installer.
centralCheck: After browser authorization, check the existing Core operation or skip
centralConfirm: Confirm linking the browser-authorized identity to this local account
centralPending: Authorization is still pending. Core enforces the polling interval and expiry.
maintenanceReview: Maintenance affects only the selected local installation. Backup pauses the authoritative Core writer briefly and encrypts data/keys; restore verification starts a new isolated database. Repair preserves original keys; uninstall removes only this installation's containers and keeps data unless separately confirmed. Diagnostics exports only allowlisted metadata, never logs or credentials. Review the selected arguments before continuing
diagnosticSaved: Local diagnostic report saved. Nothing was uploaded.
backupPassword: Backup encryption password (at least 16 characters; store separately from the backup)
deleteDataReview: Permanently remove ALL local data beneath the selected installation directory? Foreign runtimes and files outside that directory are retained
recoveryNow: Set up the existing Core owner recovery now? It pauses Core/Web briefly and requires your current OWNER password
recoveryConsole: The protected Core recovery console will open. Store the one-time offline recovery code separately from the host key and backup. It will not be captured by the installer or included in diagnostics.
haConfigure: Configure or edit Home Assistant now?
haSelectScope: Choose devices and entities. Reading is the default. Home Assistant retains physical pairing; saved consent never switches a device.
haChooseDevices: Device numbers, comma-separated, all or none
haChooseEntities: Entity numbers, comma-separated, all or none
haControlConsent: Allow supported power control for this selected device?
haControlSingle: Power control requires exactly one supported light or switch entity.
haChooseRoom: Keep the matching source room, leave unassigned, or select a room number
haSelectionReview: Save {count} selected devices and their entity, room and control permissions? No physical action occurs.
haFirstAction: Deliberately try one supported power action now?
haChooseActionDevice: Choose exactly one available device number
haActionConfirm: This will physically switch the selected device. Choose the intended action
aiPlanNow: Get local AI model recommendations for this execution device? No download or cloud activation occurs
aiPurpose: Main purpose: everyday assistance, Smart Home or coding
aiPriority: Prioritize speed, quality or lower resource use
aiConcurrent: Device use alongside AI: dedicated, work or gaming
aiBudget: Maximum AI memory budget in whole GiB
aiEstimates: Planning estimates at the stated context size, not measured performance. OS, Kyrion and concurrent use retain reserves. Download bytes are config plus model layers before protocol overhead; existing blobs may reduce the transfer. GPU drivers alone do not prove usable acceleration. No runtime settings have been changed.
aiAlternatives: No suitable recommendation with known resources. Choose another AI device or continue without AI. Cloud processing requires separate explicit consent and is not enabled here.
windowsServicesReview: Native Windows services run at machine startup with separate virtual accounts. Administrator elevation, private runtime copies, loopback PostgreSQL/Core/Web and reviewed local TLS are required. Existing Java, Node, PostgreSQL and Ollama installations are preserved. This candidate is not platform-release approved.
nativeErrorElevation: Start this downloaded installer with administrator rights to install machine services. The system review and confirmation still run before installation.
nativeErrorPort: A required local port is already occupied, or the selected address is unavailable. Resolve the reported conflict deliberately or choose another target device; existing services are preserved.
nativeErrorVersion: This native service candidate requires Windows 11 x64 (build 22000 or later). A candidate is not a platform release approval.
nativeErrorServiceHost: This historical runtime package has no signed native service host. Use a compatible schema-3 service bundle. Verification alone does not install it.
nativeErrorOwnership: The service or installation path does not meet the ownership policy. Review its permissions and identity before continuing; foreign services are not replaced.
centralOpen: Open secure provider login, or check after approving the displayed code in your browser. Cancel leaves account creation pending.
linkedOfflineIdentity: Web identity confirmed. Choose a local username and a separate offline password for this same identity. Never enter your web password here.
spaceAuthorized: Core verified your membership in this installation’s active Space. Other installations require a prepared, authorized device connection.
spaceUse: Use this authorized Space for the remaining setup?
identityAccess: Connect your web account, or use the already linked identity with its local offline password
identityReview: Core identity provider for browser-only sign-in; no website password or shared client secret is stored
offlineIdentityPolicy: Offline access uses this same linked local identity and Core membership rules. Local password sessions expire after seven days. A web-account block prevents new central login; it does not immediately revoke offline access. Local account or membership suspension takes effect through Core checks.
spaceInvitationChoice: This web account has no local membership. LINK an existing local identity, or JOIN this Space with an authorized invitation.
spaceInvitationEmail: Invitation email, if required by this Space (leave blank otherwise)
spaceInvitationEmailProof: Mailbox verification code (requires this installation’s configured mail service)
setupMemberOnly: Your membership is confirmed. Your role does not permit installation administration; an authorized administrator must configure devices and integrations.
linkExistingLocal: This local account has no web link. Explicitly connect this same identity now? Existing membership, roles and password are retained.
bootstrapExtendReview: Extend the protected first-owner setup window for 30 minutes. Available only before an owner exists. Sign-in proofs retain their separate shorter expiry.
identityErrorUnavailable: The identity provider is unavailable. Retry later; an already linked installation can use OFFLINE access. New account setup remains pending.
identityErrorConfiguration: The Core identity provider is disabled or not configured. Configure the reviewed issuer/public client before continuing; no local account has been linked by this error.
identityErrorRestart: Start a fresh sign-in operation and approve its current code. Expired, denied or consumed proofs cannot be reused.
identityErrorBootstrap: The protected first-owner credential is missing, invalid or expired. For an unfinished owned installation use --continue-setup or --extend-bootstrap with host administrator rights.
identityErrorExistingOwner: This installation already has, or is expected to have, an owner. Use the existing local identity or its recovery path; first-owner setup is unavailable.
identityErrorMembership: Sign-in alone does not grant Space access. LINK an existing local account or JOIN using an authorized Space invitation.
identityErrorInvitation: The invitation or required mailbox proof could not be redeemed. Check its expiry, remaining uses, email restriction and the issuing Space before requesting a new proof.
identityErrorLinked: This identity is already linked. Use the existing linked account; this operation does not replace a link or merge users.
identityErrorLocalAccess: Local authentication failed or the session ended. Sign in again with the local offline password, or use the consciously configured host recovery path.
identityErrorRateLimit: Core has limited repeated authentication attempts. Wait before retrying; further failed attempts can increase the delay.
identityErrorPermission: Your current role does not authorize this action. Ask a Space administrator to perform or explicitly grant the required operation.
identityErrorPasswordMismatch: The local offline passwords do not match. Restart the credential step; no password is stored by the installer.
identitySetupPaused: Account/Space setup is paused. Continue with --continue-setup on this installation; confirmed Core changes and local progress remain available.
recoveryMaintenanceReview: This host-console operation briefly stops Core and Web, leaving the database running. Core requests secrets privately. Open consumes the recovery code; complete changes the OWNER password and revokes sessions; rotate invalidates previous recovery codes. Keep newly displayed codes privately.
